Responsive

Build mobile-first interfaces with a five-tier breakpoint system and responsive display, text, spacing, and grid utilities.

Breakpoints

ZAKUIKit uses a mobile-first, min-width breakpoint system. Utilities are applied at the given width and above unless overridden.

Breakpoint Class infix Min width Container
Extra small (none) < 576px auto
Small sm 576px 540px
Medium md 768px 720px
Large lg 992px 960px
Extra large xl 1200px 1140px
2X large 2xl 1400px 1320px
css 
@media (min-width: 576px)  { /* sm */ }
@media (min-width: 768px)  { /* md */ }
@media (min-width: 992px)  { /* lg */ }
@media (min-width: 1200px) { /* xl */ }
@media (min-width: 1400px) { /* 2xl */ }

/* Useful max-widths for hiding objects below a breakpoint */
@media (max-width: 575.98px)  { /* below sm */ }
@media (max-width: 767.98px)  { /* below md */ }

Responsive Display

Show or hide elements at specific breakpoints using the display-d breakpoint-infix classes.

Display
Visible on md and up (.zak-d-md-block)
Visible below md (.zak-d-md-none)
css 
<!-- Hidden until md, then shown as block -->
<div class="zak-d-none zak-d-md-block">Visible on md+</div>

<!-- Visible until md, then hidden -->
<div class="zak-d-flex zak-d-md-none">Only below md</div>

::Display types: none, inline, inline-block, block, flex,
::inline-flex, grid + infixes (sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl)
.zak-d-md-flex .zak-d-lg-inline-flex .zak-d-xl-grid

Responsive Text

Change text alignment at different breakpoints.

Text alignment

Centered on mobile, left-aligned on md+ (zak-text-center zak-text-md-start)

Left on base, right on lg+ (zak-text-start zak-text-lg-end)

html 
<p class="zak-text-center zak-text-md-start">Center on mobile, left on md+</p>

::Available per breakpoint:
.zak-text-sm-start .zak-text-sm-center .zak-text-sm-end
.zak-text-md-start .zak-text-md-center .zak-text-md-end
.zak-text-lg-start .zak-text-lg-center .zak-text-lg-end
.zak-text-xl-start .zak-text-xl-center .zak-text-xl-end
.zak-text-2xl-start .zak-text-2xl-center .zak-text-2xl-end

Responsive Spacing

Adjust margin and padding at breakpoints to tighten mobile layouts and open up desktop layouts.

Spacing
Small padding on mobile, larger padding on md+ (zak-p-3 zak-p-md-5)
css 
<div class="zak-p-3 zak-p-md-5"></div>
<div class="zak-mt-2 zak-mt-lg-4"></div>

/* Responsive spacing follows the same naming as base
   utilities with a breakpoint infix:
   .zak-p-{breakpoint}-{size}   .zak-m-{breakpoint}-{size}
   .zak-px-{b}-{s} .zak-py-{b}-{s} .zak-mx-{b}-{s} .zak-my-{b}-{s}
   .zak-pt-{b}-{s} .zak-pb-{b}-{s} .zak-mt-{b}-{s} .zak-mb-{b}-{s} */
<div class="zak-p-sm-3 zak-p-md-4 zak-p-lg-5">Scales with each breakpoint</div>

Responsive Grid

Change column spans at breakpoints so layouts reflow naturally across device sizes.

Grid
col-md-6 (full width below md)
col-md-6
col-lg-4
col-lg-4
col-lg-4
html 
<!-- Two columns on md+, full width below -->
<div class="zak-grid zak-col-md-6">
  <div>Item 1</div>
  <div>Item 2</div>
</div>

<!-- Three columns on lg+ -->
<div class="zak-grid zak-col-lg-4">
  <div>A</div><div>B</div><div>C</div>
</div>

::Column spans available at md, lg, xl and 2xl:
.zak-col-md-1 ... .zak-col-md-12
.zak-col-lg-1 ... .zak-col-lg-12
.zak-col-xl-1 ... .zak-col-xl-12
.zak-col-2xl-1 ... .zak-col-2xl-12

Media Query Examples

Combine ZAKUIKit tokens with your own CSS media queries for full control.

css 
/* Mobile-first, min-width */
.my-layout {
  display: block;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .my-layout { display: flex; gap: var(--zak-space-4); }
}
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  .my-layout { justify-content: space-between; }
}

/* Max-width for mobile-only tweaks */
@media (max-width: 575.98px) {
  .my-hero { font-size: var(--zak-font-size-2xl); }
}

/* Respect user motion preferences */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .my-anim { transition: none; }
}

Browser Support

ZAKUIKit is built with modern CSS (custom properties, flexbox, grid, color-mix) and targets evergreen browsers.

Browser Minimum version Status
Chrome 111+ Fully supported
Edge 111+ Fully supported
Firefox 113+ Fully supported
Safari 16.4+ Fully supported
Opera 97+ Fully supported
IE / old Edge — Not supported

Accessibility

  • When hiding content with d-*-none, the element is removed from layout — ensure it is not needed by assistive technology; use .zak-visually-hidden to keep content readable by screen readers while hiding it visually.
  • Test responsive layouts with zoom and text-size increases up to 200% to be sure nothing overlaps or clips.
  • Do not rely on width alone for responsive behavior; consider touch targets (44Ã—44px minimum) on mobile.
  • Ensure interactive elements remain usable and focusable across all breakpoints.
